layout_guidance_base.Instruction: Target a compact rectangle around 45 mm x 35 mm unless enclosure forces another shape; place mounting holes near corners.
Place J1 centered on one board edge with connector overhang and shell pads per footprint drawing.
Place U1, C1, C2, and C3 within 10 mm of J1; keep VBUS_5V trace short and wider than signal traces.
Place U2 with its antenna at the opposite board edge or hanging over a board edge; keep the full antenna keepout free of copper on all layers.
Use bottom layer as continuous GND pour; stitch top/bottom GND near USB shell, regulator, ESP32, and sensors.
Route SDA/SCL from ESP32 to sensors as short 3.3 V digital traces with R3/R4 near ESP32 or bus midpoint; add TP4/TP5 before branches.
Every IC gets local 0.1 uF decoupling from supply to GND with the shortest possible return path.
Place D1 and SW1 on the top side where visible/pressable after assembly or through enclosure openings.
Place TP1 VBUS_5V, TP2 3V3, TP3 GND, TP4 SDA, and TP5 SCL along one accessible board edge.

fabrication_checklist.Acceptance: No clearance, unconnected net, solder-mask, or silkscreen-on-pad errors.
ESP32 antenna area has no copper, traces, vias, components, or mounting hardware on any layer.
Connector orientation, shell pads, VBUS/GND pins, and CC pins match the purchased part.
U1 pinout matches selected LDO; capacitors meet datasheet ESR/capacitance requirements.
Environmental sensors are not blocked by enclosure, solder mask openings, adhesive, coating, or tall parts.
Reference designators, polarity, USB orientation, and test point labels are readable.
Mark SGP30/environmental sensors as no-wash/no-conformal-coat if populated.

bringup_checklist_base.Expected result: No solder bridges on USB-C, ESP32 module pads, regulator, or sensor pins.
No short between VBUS_5V and GND or 3V3 and GND before connecting USB power.
TP1 measures about 5 V and TP2 measures 3.3 V.
Pressing SW1 pulls ESP32_EN low and releases back to 3.3 V.
ESP32 boots and toggles D1 status LED.
Firmware detects every populated sensor address.

schematic_summary_base: J1 receives USB-C 5 V power. VBUS feeds U1 VIN and GND ties to the board ground system.
R1 and R2 are 5.1 kOhm pull-down resistors from CC1 and CC2 to GND so a USB-C source enables 5 V.
U1 regulates VBUS_5V to 3V3. C1 is the input bulk capacitor; C2/C3 are output and high-frequency bypass capacitors.
U2 ESP32-WROOM-32 is powered from 3V3. GPIO21 is I2C_SDA and GPIO22 is I2C_SCL.
R3 and R4 pull I2C_SDA and I2C_SCL to 3V3. TP4 and TP5 expose the bus for debug.
D1/R5 provide a status LED from GPIO2, and SW1 pulls ESP32_EN low for reset while R6 pulls EN high.
